sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 400x300, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <=35 mK; optical: 4MP CMOS
features: anti-corrosion bi-spectrum thermal + 4MP visible positioning PTZ
uncooled VOx thermal detector (400x300, 17 um), NETD <=35 mK
thermal lens 50 / 75 / 100 mm; visible 56x optical zoom (6-336 mm)
visible IR illumination 150 m; optional near-IR laser to 800 m or 2000 m
pan 0-360 endless, tilt -45 to +90, positioning accuracy +/-0.1, 300 presets
7 alarm in / 2 out; NEMA 4X anti-corrosion for harsh environments
release_notes: Anti-corrosion multi-spectral positioning PTZ (NEMA 4X) combining a 400x300 thermal channel with a 4MP 56x visible channel, 150 m IR and an optional laser illuminator to 2 km.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible/fusion, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels (visible = channel 1, thermal = channel 2). PTZ via ONVIF.
